meta.title: Covenant Ledger — Sjórseiðr
meta.baseline: The 1221 node is the covenant's reliable anchor, imported from the Foundry covenant actor (which reads as end of Winter 1221). Earlier nodes and Current are reconstructed from it via the Ledger. Known data caveats: Wilhelm Stienauer is a Summer-1223 arrival (removed from 1221); Ka'wa'ill's recorded birth year (1220) is an error; vis stock is under review.
meta.caveat: Pre-baseline history is approximate; the actor's early data is known to be wrong/incomplete.
meta.nodesNote: Each node is the covenant's state at the end of Winter that year; 'Current' is the live state. Selecting a node re-renders every tab. Year nodes are empty skeletons until reconstructed — early data is known to be unreliable.

ledger.summary: 1223 Tribunal prizes: four vis sources won
ledger.detail: Mont-Saint-Michel Tide Pools (Aquam 5/yr), The Falcon's Cliff (Animal), The Diedne Garden (Herbam 3/yr), Norman Barrow Frost (Corpus 2/yr).

ledger.summary: 1223 Tribunal prizes: seven books won
ledger.detail: A Terram summa, a Penetration summa, a Mentem summa, an Order of Hermes Lore tractatus, a Magic Theory summa, Legends of Brittany (Faerie Lore summa), and a Spell Mastery tractatus.

ledger.summary: Prize books parked with Oleron
ledger.detail: Most prize books left at Oleron over fall/winter to cultivate the alliance and avoid sailing off with the tribunal's most valuable books amid the schism (retrievable one at a time).

ledger.summary: The Hound of Cassel becomes Wilhelm's ship
ledger.detail: The hull pirated from Scarem Montem in Summer 1221 is handed to Wilhelm, who sails it back to Scarem Montem as the trade chip for his stolen thesis. A mundane cog, no lab. Carries three sealed chests held in trust.

ledger.summary: Foxglove's unsanctioned dragon-gold
ledger.detail: ~five bags of Roman dragon-gold aboard the Tide of Memory (stolen from Tormente); near-unspendable in a silver economy, partly fenced in London. Not covenant-sanctioned wealth.

ledger.summary: Wilhelm Stienauer (Bonisagus, Rhine guest) arrives
ledger.detail: Joins the covenant as a guest magus in Summer 1223 — not present in the 1221 anchor snapshot.

ledger.summary: The Gloaming leaves the covenant
ledger.detail: The Ketch departs during 1219, before the fleet winters at Boulogne (Winter 1219-20); the exact season isn't recorded. It never rejoins the fleet.

ledger.summary: Marina (Merinita) departs with the Gloaming
ledger.detail: The Gloaming's resident magus, Marina of House Merinita, leaves the covenant when the ship does, during 1219 (before Winter 1219-20). Counted in the 1219 roster; absent thereafter.

ledger.summary: Solving Epicurusson vanishes into Twilight
ledger.detail: The founder enters Twilight and does not return in play. He remains nominally of the covenant (a 'Famous Resident') but is thereafter an absent, non-contributing member — no upkeep, votes, or seasonal service. Dagmar assumes de facto leadership.

ledger.summary: Tide of Memory passes to Dagmar
ledger.detail: Dagmar inherits the founder's flagship — with its summoning bell, astrolabe and the Master Chart — after Solving's disappearance.

ledger.summary: Stijntje Kuiper apprenticed to Dustin Page
ledger.detail: Recruited aboard the Scholar's Wake as Dustin's apprentice. (Her Arts are opened in Summer 1222.)

ledger.summary: Kor Ex Flambeau joins the covenant
ledger.detail: Meets Nequam in the Hebrides and takes over his ship and covenant obligations; a wandering, justice-driven knight-errant.

ledger.summary: The Maelstrom's Maw passes to Kor
ledger.detail: Nequam of Tytalus hands the Knarr to Kor Ex Flambeau in exchange for a vague promise of future partnership.

ledger.summary: Nequam of Tytalus leaves the covenant
ledger.detail: Divested himself of covenant obligations when he handed off the Maelstrom's Maw (Summer 1220); last attested Fall 1220. Departed — not a member thereafter.

ledger.summary: Veðrdreki (the Storm Dragon) joins the fleet
ledger.detail: Valdemar's personal Viking drakar, the Veðrdreki, is counted as a covenant hull from 1221 (Valdemar joined in Winter 1220-21).

ledger.summary: Valdemar Bjornsson (Diedne) joins the covenant
ledger.detail: A skyclad Viking war-magus and centuries-old regio survivor; brings the Veðrdreki. Joined in Winter 1220-21; counted toward the covenant from 1221.

ledger.summary: The Hound of Cassel captured
ledger.detail: Valdemar's crew raids the Scarem Montem merchantman (mundane goods, legal under Normandy law), taking three magically-sealed chests and the letter that exposed the imprisoned Valerian de Castellane. A laid-up prize berthed at the Isle of Man; no lab. Becomes Wilhelm's ship in Spring 1224.

ledger.summary: Kor Ex Flambeau goes on sabbatical
ledger.detail: Kor departs on his hovering-stone-platform project with the Maelstrom's Maw. He remains a covenant member in good standing but is thereafter an absent, non-contributing member — no upkeep, votes, or seasonal service — until his return.

ledger.summary: The Maelstrom's Maw goes on sabbatical
ledger.detail: Off the active roster with Kor; a held asset, not lost — the Master Chart simply no longer tracks it while he is away.

ledger.summary: The Adamant joins the fleet
ledger.detail: The fleet's fifth hull, commissioned at Bergen and earmarked (per Solving's notes) for the Guernicus mage; given to Valerian on his arrival.

ledger.summary: Valerian de Castellane (Guernicus) arrives
ledger.detail: Rescued from imprisonment; joins as an uneasy ally, bringing the Adamant. (The 1221 actor anchor lists him a season early; his true arrival is Spring 1222.)

ledger.summary: Rosie familiared to Dustin
ledger.detail: The magical pig Rosie becomes Dustin's familiar; sails with the Scholar's Wake thereafter. (Not counted against ship crew.)

ledger.summary: Valdemar's raid crew forms on the Veðrdreki
ledger.detail: For the Hound of Cassel raid, Valdemar's Veðrdreki takes on Garrat Coffin and Ka'wa'ill (both from the Brineborn) and Leofwin (from the Tide of Memory), alongside Giden and Angus McPeterson. These stick as the drakar's standing crew.

ledger.summary: Absalom moves to captain the Tide of Memory
ledger.detail: When the Maelstrom's Maw goes on sabbatical with Kor, its captain Absalom transfers to the Tide of Memory under Dagmar.

ledger.summary: Rán boards the Veðrdreki as Valdemar's wife
ledger.detail: The deep-sea fae Valdemar wed emerges in human form and joins the drakar (an NPC; not counted against ship crew).

ledger.summary: Wilhelm's household joins
ledger.detail: Wilhelm's scribe Hilda, research assistants Carl and Isaac, and his brother Dietrich travel with him (aboard the Brineborn in 1223, the Hound of Cassel from 1224). Guests — not counted against ship crew.
